article:
[h3]This is [s]Sparta![/s] [u]Aowow[/u][/h3]

A project for private servers to sensibly display the vast amount of data a private server contains.

Built with TrinityCore in my neck, but i'm trying to get away from that .. some time.
With it's own data structure it shouldn't be too hard to write a converter for MaNGOS, Ascent or whatever software you prefere.

The expected version is 3.3.5 (12340), everything else will get messy.
